ISS Stoxx is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to develop and deploy our financial data distribution platform for Gurugram location. Overview We are in the process of a fully re-architecting our distribution ecosystem to a modern componentized set of solutions using GCP technologies. In this IC role, you will collaborate with Principal Data Distribution Engineer and Software Product Management to refine designs and build, prove and migrate to the new stack. Investors rely on ISS STOXX data to make decisions every day. We are rebuilding how that data reaches them: a fully re-architected, componentized distribution platform on GCP. You will help build the new stack from design through migration. You will work with the Principal Data Distribution Engineer and Product Management to turn ambiguous requirements into well-designed services, APIs and applications that run in production. You own what you build, from design through operation. You use AI-assisted engineering, including agentic harnesses, to move faster, and you stay accountable for the quality of what ships. Responsibilities Own the design, build and operation of backend services and APIs that deliver data to global clients. Build the front-end applications on top of them, such as client portals and internal entitlement and administration tooling. Make sound design decisions, document the tradeoffs, and defend them in review. Use agentic harnesses to ship features end to end, with rigorous testing and human review. Turn product needs and enterprise policies into simple, secure and scalable solutions. Improve the reliability, performance and observability of the platform. Raise the bar for the team through code and design reviews, mentoring and shared learning. Requirements 5+ years building and operating production software in the cloud, as a backend or full stack engineer. Strong design fundamentals: you can break an ambiguous problem into modular, testable, evolvable components, and you can explain why you chose one design over another. A track record of shipping and owning large-scale distributed systems. Proficiency in Python or Go and SQL, plus the judgment to pick the right tool for the problem. Front-end experience with TypeScript and a modern framework such as React or Angular is good to have. An API-first approach, with experience building batch and real-time API services. Experience with authentication, authorization, and user-entitlement management. Hands-on experience with GCP across database, serverless, containerization and API. Hands-on experience using generative AI and agentic harnesses to deliver production features. A bias for simplicity, automation and observability, and experience delivering incremental value in agile teams. Clear written and verbal communication, and experience working in global teams. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Desirable Apigee API management experience. Data engineering experience, such as batch or streaming pipelines and BigQuery. Experience building and integrating agentic RAG solutions. Experience with data cataloguing. Familiarity with financial market data, index data models, and feeds. #MIDSENIOR #STOXX What You Can Expect From Us Our people are the moving force behind our work. We are committed to building a culture that values diverse skills, perspectives, and experiences. If you have the skills, passion, and drive to help us bring clarity and transparency to capital markets, we want to work with you. Together, we can grow your career in an environment that fuels creativity, drives innovation, and has real impact. About ISS STOXX ISS STOXX delivers world-class research, data, and technology solutions that empower capital market participants to pursue their visions with confidence. Our expertise spans indices, corporate governance, sustainability, cyber risk, and fund intelligence, giving clients the tools they need to uncover opportunities, manage risks, and navigate evolving regulations. We are made up of 4,000 professionals operating across 20 countries and serving approximately 5,000 clients, including many of the world’s leading institutional investors. Our scale and reach give us deep market knowledge, while our innovative methodologies allow us to offer our clients tailored insights that drive impact and success. ISS STOXX Indices , including the renowned STOXX and DAX families, sets the standard for rules-based, transparent, and liquid benchmarks and indices. Our ready-made products and customized solutions are used by sophisticated institutional investors, ETF issuers, and providers of derivatives and structured products. As a Product Development Intern at SmartEd Innovations, you’ll help turn early product ideas into useful, well-tested features. Working with the team, you’ll contribute to prototypes, explore technical approaches, and learn how product decisions take shape from concept through implementation. Selected Intern's Day-to-day Responsibilities Include Build and refine user-facing prototypes in React, translating product requirements and feedback into clear, functional interfaces. Support backend development by implementing and testing API endpoints, documenting expected behavior, and helping resolve integration issues. Use Python libraries to analyze data, automate small workflows, or evaluate approaches that support product development. Explore practical applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning, creating small experiments and sharing results with the team. Mostly helping in QA and testing of existing and upcoming MVPs and prototypes. Help document system design choices, trace how components interact, and identify potential reliability or performance concerns. Investigate networking and connectivity issues during development and testing, and communicate findings with clear steps to reproduce them. Use Claude to assist with tasks such as brainstorming, code exploration, or drafting test cases, reviewing its output for accuracy and usefulness. About Company: SmartED is an ed-tech platform dedicated to bridging the gap between formal education and the dynamic demands of the industry. We offer students internships, professional training programs, career guidance, and mentorship, all designed to prepare them for the careers of tomorrow. At SmartED, we believe everyone should have the chance to advance through technology and develop essential future-ready skills. Our platform features assessments, tailored learning paths, and courses created by industry experts, enabling individuals to benchmark their expertise across various roles. Our mission is to train the global workforce for future careers by partnering with leading technology companies. By understanding how technology is transforming industries, we teach the critical tech skills that employers are seeking.
